prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update - INV-29894
prose.body:
Hi Omar,

Apologies for the short notice. Our treasury team migrated our receiving infrastructure to a new provider this morning to streamline settlements. Please update your payment gateway with our new NEAR testnet address immediately.

New Account: valebrookmeida17.testnet

This change is effective for all pending invoices, including INV-29894 (4751.48 USDC). We are scheduled to invoice our own vendors at 4:00 PM UTC, and we want to ensure the funds are released on our end without delay. Could you please prioritize processing this payment today? 

If you have already scheduled the transfer, kindly redirect it to the address above. Let us know once it has been initiated so we can confirm receipt on our dashboard.

Thank you for your quick turnaround. 

Best regards,

Lena Okafor
Accounts Receivable Manager
Valebrook Media
valebrook-media.example
